title: Choose Your First Offer
summary: Compare an intensive, lab, and kit with one evidence-bound scorecard and choose the fastest truthful offer hypothesis to validate.
triggers: compare an intensive, cohort, and digital product

inputs.name: confirmed audience, constraints, and evidence summary

outputs.name: offer decision and Proof Loop Map

free_capabilities: optional ChatGPT Sites validation handoff; provider access may be required
paid_capability_stubs: connected owned-evidence reads depend on current Threadify scopes and entitlement

instructions: Use a reviewed niche report and owner-supplied constraints when connected evidence is unavailable.
Label incomplete coverage and unknown counts instead of inventing them.
Keep the validation page inactive and report that no market test occurred.
